title: Tanzanian Chicken Stew
author: Mama Salima
desc: Kuku wa Mchuzi — everyday Tanzanian chicken stew. Bone-in chicken pieces simmered in a simple, fragrant tomato and onion sauce with garlic, ginger, and warm spices. The everyday family chicken dish of Tanzania — simple, satisfying, and endlessly made.
longDesc: Kuku wa Mchuzi is different from the spiced curry version — it is lighter, simpler, and more about the natural flavour of the chicken and the quality of the tomato-onion sauce. It is the everyday chicken stew that Tanzanian mothers make on ordinary weekdays.
steps: Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, curry powder. Stir 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes. Cook 8 minutes until thick.
Return chicken. Add water. Simmer covered 30—35 minutes.
chefTips: Simple is the key — this dish is about the chicken, not the spice.
Bone-in chicken provides much more flavour.
commonMistakes: Over-spicing — this is a gentle, everyday stew.
cookingScience: See TZA026 for chicken stew science.
culturalNote: Kuku wa Mchuzi is the taste of an ordinary Tuesday in Tanzania — the smell that means a normal, happy family dinner is on the way. Its simplicity is its strength.
